import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for x,c,p in zip(r[70:],['ъ','ьъъ','ь','ь'],['yes','yes','no','no']):
 a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):v for i,v in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918=p,note=''))
open('answers.jsonl','w').writelines(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in a)
b=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(r)==len(b)
for x,y in zip(r,b):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected==set(y['confidence'])
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(v for y in b for v in y['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(b))
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in b))
PY
